hero:
Your digital life.
A little more protected.
intro: A suspicious message? An unexpected call? Get clear, evidence-led guidance and take your next step with confidence.
private: No account needed · Local analysis by default
urgentTitle: Lost money to cyber fraud? Act now.
urgent: Contact your bank immediately. Call 1930 and report at the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. Keep transaction records and screenshots.
toolsSub: From the first doubt to the right reporting channel.
detectDesc: Inspect messages, links, emails and screenshots for warning signs.
responseDesc: Organise the facts and prepare an editable complaint draft.
awarenessDesc: Recognise common scams before they reach you.
reportingDesc: Find verified Indian government reporting destinations.
labIntro: Paste suspicious content or upload a screenshot / .eml email. Do not include passwords, OTPs, PINs or full payment credentials.
placeholder: Paste the message, URL or email here…
upload: Or upload a file (PNG, JPG, WEBP, EML · up to 5 MB)
consent: Allow external AI explanation for this check. Detected snippets will be sent to the configured remote provider and may contain personal information.
noFindings: No configured warning pattern matched. This is inconclusive, not a safety guarantee.
responseTitle: Turn the facts into a next step.
responseIntro: Prepare a draft for your own review. This app never submits complaints or sends emails.
evidence: Evidence checklist: messages, screenshots, transaction records
save: Save this incident on the local device
awarenessTitle: Know the pattern. Break the scam.
awarenessIntro: A practical, offline library for everyday digital safety.
reportingTitle: The right help. The official route.
reportingIntro: Opening a portal does not file a complaint. Follow its submission steps and keep the acknowledgement.
footer: Built for awareness. Designed for action.
privacy: Evidence is processed in memory unless you choose to save an incident. Local history is unencrypted; expired records are purged on the next history operation. No threat database or identity verification is performed.
error: Unable to complete this action. Check your input and try again.
fileError: Choose a supported file up to 5 MB.
recheck: Language changed. Run the check again to translate the assessment.
validation: Please complete this field with a valid value.
developer: Developed by ARK Team of MC² (MCTE Coding Club)
slogan: DON’T LET FEAR STOP YOU. REPORTING A SCAM IS THE NEXT RIGHT STEP.
sloganNote: Anyone can be targeted. You are not alone. Report promptly and take steps to protect yourself.
counterNote: Saved in this app · not official complaints · today uses IST
date_unknown: I do not know the incident date
time_unknown: I do not know the incident time
dateTimeHelp: Enter each value or explicitly mark it unknown.
pinDisclosure: Online lookup sends only the PIN code to Postal PIN Code API, a third-party directory. You can enter the location manually instead. Confirm the suggested area; it does not establish police jurisdiction.
pinNone: No matching locality found. Enter the location manually.
senderTitle: Where did the communication come from?
sender_phone: Sender phone number (optional; include country code if known)
senderNote: A foreign number is not proof of fraud; an Indian number is not proof of legitimacy. Caller IDs can be spoofed. Verify the claimed identity independently.
internationalNumber: This number uses a non-Indian international prefix. That alone does not establish fraud.
indianNumber: The number uses India’s +91 prefix. This does not verify the caller’s identity.
attachmentHelp: Up to 3 files, 5 MB combined: PNG, JPG, WEBP, PDF, TXT or EML. Files are retained only when you save the incident. Draft text lists filenames; exports do not bundle the files.
attachmentLimit: Select at most 3 files with a combined size up to 5 MB.
unsavedFiles: Attachments were checked but not retained. Save the incident to keep them locally.
bankIntro: Choose a bank for its reporting contact. These five starter entries serve customers in India, including HSBC India.
bankNote: Numbers are country-specific. Check the official source before calling; calling or opening a page does not itself lodge a complaint.
videoInternet: YouTube links require internet. Written advisories remain available locally.
demoSoon: A YouTube walkthrough of DIGI SURAKSHA will be posted here soon.
advisoryIntro: Add a title, useful guidance and its HTTPS source. Submissions stay out of the public library until reviewed on this local installation.
advisoryFile: Optional PDF, TXT or image (up to 5 MB)
advisorySubmitted: Advisory uploaded and awaiting review. It has not been published.
reviewIntro: For the operator of this local app: inspect the content and source before publishing. These controls have no separate login; keep this server local.
reviewed: I have reviewed this content and its source
privacyDetails: Incident text and attachments are saved only when you select Save. Saved incidents expire after 30 days and are removed on the next incident/history operation. They are stored unencrypted on this computer and accessible to other local app users. Deleting an incident removes its attachments; cumulative anonymous daily counts remain. Advisory uploads are retained separately until removed by the local operator. PIN lookup sends only a PIN code to a third-party directory when you request it. TXT drafts list attachments but do not contain those files. No complaints or emails are sent by this app.
pinInvalid: Enter a six-digit Indian PIN code.
